Messages.Author: ICL
Messages.Body:
Touch of Clarity, Action Modifier/Reaction, 1 blood, Dementation
Usable by an acting minion or any untapped ready minion.
[dem] Cancel a non-combat card that requires Dementation, Dominate [dom] or Presence  as it is played (no cost is paid). Tap this vampire.
[DEM] As above, but do not tap this vampire.

MethA controls Vamp1 and Vamp2. Vamp1 bleeds. MethB plays Deflection. Is there any reason an untapped Vamp2 couldn't play Touch of Clarity?

Point being that "any untapped ready minion" overrides usual inability of nonacting minions to play action modifiers, correct?

Traveller Card Game
